items.primary_title: Phase III Study of Niraparib Plus Pembrolizumab as Maintenance Therapy for Advanced or Metastatic NSCLC (ZEAL-1L)
items.design: Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, phase III maintenance trial
items.setting: Advanced/metastatic squamous or nonsquamous NSCLC without known targetable driver alteration, after first-line chemotherapy plus pembrolizumab

interventions.experimental: Niraparib 300 mg or 200 mg orally once daily plus pembrolizumab 200 mg IV every 3 weeks
interventions.control: Placebo plus pembrolizumab 200 mg IV every 3 weeks

items.primary_endpoint: BICR-assessed PFS in patients with CR/PR after first-line chemotherapy plus pembrolizumab
items.primary_result: Median PFS 5.55 months in both arms; HR 1.00 (95% CI 0.79–1.27); one-sided P=0.502.
items.secondary_endpoint_status: Hierarchical testing stopped after the primary endpoint failed; ITT PFS, OS in CR/PR and ITT populations, and CNS time-to-progression were not formally tested.
items.safety: Most common grade ≥3 treatment-related adverse events with niraparib were hematologic (anemia, thrombocytopenia, neutropenia); abstract reports no new safety signal. Exact overall grade ≥3 rates not stated in the accessible abstract.
items.reason: Negative phase III primary endpoint; adding niraparib to pembrolizumab maintenance did not improve efficacy. Retain as contrary evidence rather than a new positive trial page.
items.action: Keep as a single canonical negative-evidence record; attach later follow-up if published and revisit only if it becomes essential to interpret a current recommendation.
